resolved_owners.resolution: Caller-owned canonical table, physics/tail, scene and arena identities remain borrowed. The packet ownership map identifies each producer and consumer; no second authoritative global or cache is introduced.

classification_limits: Exactly the five complete files named in the independent standards review conform within their bounded purpose. This does not approve every source file, whole player, Session or campaign.

src/runtime/gamma_actor_assets.reason: Explicit whole single-member header-only module review. Native imported declaration types are semantic, but the public animation_table exposes the legacy fixture-availability record representation to native game consumers.
src/runtime/gamma_actor_assets.semantic_justification: ResourceIds in joins and cursor arrays are one-based typed pack record IDs; zero join references are observed null. ActionHandle resolves a pack Action, not the original DLL address. ActorResourceStatus separates real known-null export61 from unavailable imported payloads and Loaded records; boundary text is importer diagnostic provenance, never a dispatch key. GammaAnimationRecipe stores animation content (object count/mode/next/transition/speed), not an instruction recipe. However shared_ptr<const PlayerAnimationTable> carries outer optional fields for absent fixture facts into game-tier native state.

resolved_owners.resolution: PlayerSystem uniquely owns GammaActorAssets; it also owns mutable weld/cursor tables. Session owns the one pack and mutable SceneState; weld pointers resolve exact ObjectState objects and cursor points/colors/indices resolve GeometryState arrays. Actors share the immutable animation table while mutable copied collision work stays arena-owned. line_colors is mutable resource data borrowed by Gamma State, not a palette address. No second palette/material owner is justified.

resolved_consumers.resolution: App marks each unavailable action explicitly then builds91 legacy PlayerAnimationRecords: only action uses known-null versus unknown optional; numeric recipe fields are present. Native bind_animation_table publishes this legacy table into canonical player animation state. Welds/cursors use actual scene pointers. Mode0 uses request0 Stand; native material(), setup/effects, PSetMotion and model-matrix functions still fail loudly. Imported material metadata is not yet represented in this header or bound by native material().

accepted_judges.accepted_scope: Migrate the animation content contract together with real player animation consumers/reference adaptation; retain Loaded/KnownNull/Unavailable distinctions and fail at the same boundary. Do not replace absent import payloads with null or fabricate materials/setup behavior. Existing player_animation.cpp has live PC-based known()/stop()/record() diagnostics and fixture availability in game decisions; this is adjacent maintained migration debt, not addresses hidden in ResourceId.
